title: Necropolis monster (Doctor Frankenstein proposal)
description: A recomposition proposal: certified organs from ORGANS.jsonl (plus explicitly novel organs) assembled into a new organism with a lightning experiment. Governed by ROLES.md F1-F6. A monster is NOT a resurrection and NOT evidence about any ancestor (F2).

kind.description: chimera = many graves, one organism (F1-F6). repair = one ancestor, exactly one change: had they only done this instead (F7). A repair requires counterfactual_repair and a feasible ancestral comparison.

premise_summary.description: One paragraph: what the assembled organism is supposed to DO, stated as a mechanism, not a hope.

graves_raided.description: Source agents (ROSTER agent_ids) whose organs are harvested. Informational; derived from organs[].

organ_id.description: Must resolve to ORGANS.jsonl unless novel=true. Novel organs use the prefix novel.

source_agent.description: ROSTER agent_id, or NOVEL for organs not harvested from a grave.

contributes.description: The causal function this organ supplies to the monster. Not what it was; what it does HERE.

modification_required.description: What must change about the organ before it fits. Empty string = used as-is.

failures_recorded_against.description: Copied from ORGANS.jsonl at proposal time so the Cleric sees the organ history (F6).

organ_execution_plan.description: Required when any harvested organ has executed_by_necromancer != true in ORGANS.jsonl: how each such organ will be executed and checked against its dossier description before the experiment reads anything from it (LAW N17, F7).

ancestor.description: ROSTER agent_id of the single ancestor being repaired.

the_one_change.description: Exactly one change. If it takes more than one sentence to state, it is probably more than one change.

error_class.description: Which recorded error the change targets (from the ancestor dossier's contributing_axes / author_error_audit).

error_evidence.description: The dossier field or evidence file that established the error being repaired.

record_check.description: Did the ancestor's own history ever run the repaired configuration? Cite the search. If yes, the repair is dead-on-record and must not be proposed (F7).

why_combination_changes_boundary.description: Which historical kill boundary (name the dossier + the boundary) this assembly is claimed to move, and the mechanism by which recombination moves it. Modern-models-are-better is not a mechanism.

capability.description: The specific modern capability, or: none, this is pure recomposition of era-1 organs.

era_test.description: How the experiment separates capability-moved-the-boundary from recomposition-moved-the-boundary (LAW N16).

consumption_proof.description: The CONSUMPTION.jsonl seam entry (SEAMS.md) that would prove the monster output was used, or why no such seam exists yet.

measurable_consequence.description: What changes, in a number the consumer already reads, if the monster is alive.

strongest_alternative_explanation.description: The best non-monster explanation for a positive result. The experiment must be able to separate it.

kill_condition.description: Pre-declared, numeric where possible, and able to fire AGAINST the proposer (LAW N9, F3).

chance_floor.description: Published P(result | no mechanism), with the null that produces it.

positive_control.description: Something the instrument is known to detect; if it fails to fire, the experiment is uninformative, not a kill.

ancestral_assembly.description: The historical assembly run under the SAME instrument (F4), or the closest recoverable proxy.

rationale.description: Why this comparison measures evolutionary movement (or why it is infeasible).

ancestral_result_on_record.description: If the ancestral number already exists under this instrument, cite it with its dossier path.

vindication_disclaimer.const: A plausible modern reconstruction does not vindicate the historical agent, invalidate its autopsy, or constitute evidence that the original premise was correct. If this monster lives, the conditional viability frontier moved; Prometheus 1.0 did not succeed retroactively.

dossier_if_dead.description: dossiers/<monster_id>.dossier.json once a Necromancer has autopsied the corpse (F6).

organs_inventory_sha.description: sha256 of ORGANS.jsonl at proposal time, computed over LF-normalized bytes (certificates must fingerprint inputs; line endings must not change the certificate).
